references.text: Confirms Tamar's role as the matriarch of Perez and Zerah in Judah's genealogy.
Directly alludes to the event in Genesis 38 to include Tamar in the Messianic lineage.
Continues the same narrative by showing the consequence of Tamar's actions.
Uses Tamar's story as a theological foreshadowing of Ruth's entry into Judah's house.
